sources.title: ai-portfolio-zmin/CNN_on_cifar - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project implements a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) from scratch in PyTorch to classify images from the CIFAR-10 dataset. The goal is to demonstrate an end-to-end deep learning workflow: data loading, model design, training, evaluation, and inference — in a clean, portfolio-ready codebase.
